title: Unified Customer 360 Across ERP, Commerce and Support
raw_text: Repost of the customer 360 integration, extended to cover the two additional regional banner groups acquired since the original notice was published. Scope and constraints are unchanged from the original notice: identity resolution across ERP, e-commerce, marketing, and support, on GCP with BigQuery as the analytical landing zone, with consent propagation to all downstream systems within one day. This entry exists to demonstrate that the detection service treats a re-announced tender as the same tender rather than a second one.
requirements: System integration unifying Cegid ERP, commerce, marketing, and support records
Identity resolution on email, loyalty number, and postcode fallback
BigQuery analytical landing zone on GCP
Consent and opt-out propagation to downstream systems within 24 hours
